from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Represents the financial data extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date (e.g., '2025-03' or '2025-Q1')")
    financial_expenses: float | None = Field(description="Financial Expenses amount (元)")
    total_operating_costs: float | None = Field(description="Total Operating Costs amount (元)")
    net_profit_attributable: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders (元)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
